title: The Great 80s Thanksgiving Debate: Cast Your Votes and Listen to the Countdown
summary: Vote for your favorites, then tune in to 80s on 8 on Thanksgiving Day and throughout the weekend to hear the results!
body_markdown: Some debates shouldn’t happen at[Thanksgiving](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/thanksgiving) … but these should![80s on 8 (Ch. 8)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/80s-on-8) is letting YOU settle 26 of the biggest debates of the decade. Cast your votes in the categories below, then listen to 80s on 8 on satellite channel 8 and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTop8080sCountdown?source=streaming_banner) all Thanksgiving weekend as we reveal the winners and play the songs you chose!
